ssprinklez_: Day 4: Viktor Ssprinklez reached R-F2 with a full packet of cigarettes. Learning everyone's name proved remarkably easy. The signallers took Viktor Ssprinklez in on a busy morning in R-F2. By noon he had learned the first rule of the job, and by evening the second.

Viktor Ssprinklez tested the telephone and heard someone at headquarters chewing. The line was declared perfectly clear. Mail came up the line with a letter for Viktor Ssprinklez. Viktor Ssprinklez read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.
